title: Super-Gas-Free-Chain
tagline: In this chain every project can chose to deposit some gas for their user. so the user can use their DAPP for free(in gas)
description: In this chain every project can chose to deposit some gas for their user. so the user can use their DAPP for free(in gas), I will design a new contract and change the logical in op-stack to adapt it. I will change the logic when transaction get in to txpool and check if these transaction is valid with the rules in gas free police, and modify the execution layer part which is charging the gas fee.
how_its_made: only modify the OP-STACK. In this chain every project can chose to deposit some gas for their user. so the user can use their DAPP for free(in gas), I will design a new contract and change the logical in op-stack to adapt it. I will change the logic when transaction get in to txpool and check if these transaction is valid with the rules in gas free police, and modify the execution layer part which is charging the gas fee.I've made modifications to the op-node and op-geth, and I've also introduced a feegate smart contract. This contract is used by DApp developers to deposit gas fees for their users to use.
